Technical details, implementation and checks

Recorded description. Review status in this text reflects when it was written; see the accepted review for its current scope. Bounded source-linked ordinary Kelvin–Voigt law with deviatoric viscosity and purely elastic bulk. Six-strain physical-time state; creep, constant rate and strain hold in the main laboratory. Small strain, dry total stress, fixed frame/zero spin. Explicit incoming rates determine initial stress. Illustrative uncalibrated parameters; no experimental validation or broad parameter qualification.

Definition, conventions & preparation

COMSOL 6.3 Kelvin–Voigt Eq. 3-36: parallel deviatoric spring and dashpot with purely elastic bulk. Physical seconds; six persistent total infinitesimal strain components. Fixed spatial frame, zero spin; compression-positive Mandel tensors and dry total Cauchy stress. Parameters K, G (Pa), tau (s); viscosity G tau. Creep holds the incoming stress defined by explicit initial strain and initial rate. A strain hold immediately sheds viscous stress and then preserves elastic stress. No experimental validation or broad material calibration is claimed.
